decision_basis: Use a separately named, architecture-compatible Apache-2.0 checkpoint while original-LLaMA1 access is unconfirmed. Choice was based on license/architecture/tokenizer behavior, not recommendation test performance.

tokenizer.reason: The publisher warns against automatically converted fast tokenizers; retain the author's explicit instruction strings.

semantic_encoding.pooling: Mask-mean each field separately, then equally average field embeddings.
semantic_encoding.text_cleaning: Preserve the pinned author clean_text transform, including dropping fields at 2000 characters.

tokenizer_training.teacher: The completed training-only 32D BCE SASRec reconstruction, not an unreleased original teacher.

isolation.released_id_decoder_bringup_if_used: A separately labeled hybrid, not the end-to-end method comparison.
isolation.paper_targets: Context only; do not label alternative-backbone scores as original-LLaMA1 reproduced results.

required_gates: Verify immutable model/tokenizer bytes and the complete architecture.
Use the correct slow tokenizer and verify atomic added tokens and response-prefix matching.
Audit every formatted input/target and semantic field before fitting.
Verify real int8 forward/backward, active embedding/head gradients and save/reload.
Verify complete optimizer/RNG continuation and full-user fixed-beam evaluation.
